import "./domEnvironment.js";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import campaignScenarioData from "../src/data/campaign01.json";
import type { CampaignScenarioData } from "../src/core/campaignTypes";
import type { SerializedBattleState } from "../src/game/GameEngine";
import type { CampaignBattlePackage } from "../src/game/campaign/engagements/CampaignEngagementLedgerTypes";
import { createCampaignFormationBattleSeed } from "../src/game/campaign/formations/CampaignFormationBattleAdapter";
import { extractCampaignBattleResultPackage } from "../src/game/campaign/results/CampaignBattleResultExtractor";
import type { CampaignBattleResultOutcome } from "../src/game/campaign/results/CampaignBattleResultTypes";
import type { CampaignRuntimeState } from "../src/game/campaign/runtime/campaignRuntimeTypes";
import { InMemoryCampaignSaveBackend } from "../src/game/campaign/persistence/CampaignSaveBackend";
import { CampaignSaveRepository } from "../src/game/campaign/persistence/CampaignSaveRepository";
import { CampaignState } from "../src/state/CampaignState";

function terminalResult(runtime: CampaignRuntimeState, pkg: CampaignBattlePackage, outcome: CampaignBattleResultOutcome) {
  const units = pkg.formationCommitments.map((entry, index) => {
    const seed = createCampaignFormationBattleSeed(runtime.formations[entry.formationId], {
      campaignId: pkg.campaignId, engagementId: pkg.engagementId,
      sourceRevision: pkg.sourceRevision, sourceSegment: pkg.committedSegment, hex: { q: index, r: 0 }
    });
    assert.ok(seed);
    return { faction: entry.faction, unit: seed.unit };
  });
  const supplyState = () => ({
    inventory: {
      ammo: { current: 0, baseline: 0, bonus: 0 }, fuel: { current: 0, baseline: 0, bonus: 0 },
      rations: { current: 0, baseline: 0, bonus: 0 }, parts: { current: 0, baseline: 0, bonus: 0 }
    }, pending: [], productionRate: { ammo: 0, fuel: 0, rations: 0, parts: 0 }, ledger: [], lastUpdatedTurn: 35
  });
  const tacticalState: SerializedBattleState = {
    completeStateVersion: 1, phase: "completed", activeFaction: "Player", turnNumber: 35, baseCamp: null,
    playerPlacements: units.filter(entry => entry.faction === "Player").map(entry => entry.unit),
    botPlacements: units.filter(entry => entry.faction === "Bot").map(entry => entry.unit), allyPlacements: [],
    reserves: [], airborneReserves: [], casualtyLog: [], battleRequisitionPointsSpent: 0,
    enemyContactStates: [], hexModifications: [], supplyStates: { Player: supplyState(), Bot: supplyState(), Ally: supplyState() }
  };
  return extractCampaignBattleResultPackage({ battlePackage: pkg, tacticalState, missionStatus: null, result: outcome });
}

async function produce(priorCounterattack: boolean) {
  const backend = new InMemoryCampaignSaveBackend();
  const state = new CampaignState({ legacyStorage: null, saveBackend: backend });
  state.setScenario(structuredClone(campaignScenarioData) as CampaignScenarioData);
  const first = state.advanceCampaign({ mode: "segment" });
  assert.ok(first.ok);
  if (priorCounterattack) {
    const second = state.advanceCampaign({ mode: "segment" });
    assert.ok(second.ok && second.state.activeEngagementId);
    const pkg = second.state.engagementLedger[second.state.activeEngagementId].package;
    assert.ok(pkg);
    state.applyCampaignBattleResult(terminalResult(second.state, pkg, "stalemate"));
  }
  const prepared = state.prepareCampaignFrontEngagement({
    engagementId: "fsg-014-omaha", frontKey: "omaha_gold", attacker: "Player", requestedTargetHexKey: "24,24"
  });
  assert.ok(prepared.ok);
  state.setPendingEngagements([prepared.engagement]);
  state.setActiveEngagementId(prepared.engagement.id);
  const planned = state.getRuntimeSnapshot();
  assert.ok(planned);
  const committed = state.commitCampaignEngagement({ engagementId: prepared.engagement.id, expectedRevision: planned.revision,
    selections: [{ allocationKey: "infantry", category: "units", quantity: 1, unitRpCost: 50 }] });
  assert.ok(committed.ok);
  const runtime = state.getRuntimeSnapshot();
  assert.ok(runtime);
  state.applyCampaignBattleResult(terminalResult(runtime, committed.package, "attackerVictory"));
  const after = state.getRuntimeSnapshot();
  assert.ok(after);
  assert.equal(after.compatibility.initialFronts.find(front => front.key === "caen_airborne_flank")?.initiative, "Player");
  if (!priorCounterattack) {
    // Reproduce the already-persisted live defect, including the missed due window.
    const missed = state.advanceCampaign({ mode: "segment" });
    assert.ok(missed.ok);
    assert.equal(missed.state.currentSegment, 2);
    assert.equal(missed.state.activeEngagementId, null);
    assert.equal(missed.state.compatibility.initialFronts.find(front => front.key === "caen_airborne_flank")?.initiative, "Player");
  }
  const request = { timestamp: "2026-09-06T07:00:00.000Z", buildVersion: "99a3df1", contentVersion: "campaign-content-1",
    label: "FSG-CAM-014 old-writer post-battle fixture", commanderRosterLink: null,
    playTimeSeconds: 0, difficulty: "Normal", uiResumeContext: { workspace: "theater" as const, selectedEntityId: null, mapCenter: null, mapZoom: null } };
  const slot = await state.savePostBattleAutosave(prepared.engagement.id, request);
  const loaded = await new CampaignSaveRepository(backend).loadSlot(slot.slotId, { observedAt: request.timestamp });
  assert.ok(loaded.ok);
  return { slot, envelope: loaded.envelope };
}

const commit = '99a3df14a050c461ed98b8cc8cd94ffc3e7d3ae9';
const artifact = {
  sourceCommit: commit,
  sourceControlBlob: execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', `${commit}:src/game/campaign/control/CampaignBattleControlResolver.ts`], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(),
  provenance: 'Unmodified production source. Ordinary campaign advances including a missed due counterattack window, canonical commitment/result extraction and real result application, savePostBattleAutosave, verified repository load. No audit/hash edits.',
  beforeCounterattack: await produce(false),
  afterResolvedCounterattack: await produce(true)
};
writeFileSync('tests/fixtures/CampaignFrontInitiative.99a3df1.json', JSON.stringify(artifact) + '\n');
console.log(JSON.stringify({ sourceCommit: artifact.sourceCommit, sourceControlBlob: artifact.sourceControlBlob,
  bytes: JSON.stringify(artifact).length, saves: 2 }));
